adType.description: Offers are listings for sale or rent; demands are wanted ads.
adType.title: Ad type

category.description: Leboncoin category ID used when no search URL is pasted. Common IDs: 9 = property sales, 10 = rentals, 2 = cars, 6 = car parts, 17 = phones, 33 = jobs. You can find any other ID in a leboncoin.fr search URL after ?category=.
category.title: Category ID

condition.description: Goods filter. Values: 1 = new, 6 = refurbished, 2 = very good, 3 = good, 7 = fair, 5 = for parts.
condition.title: Item condition

contractType.description: Jobs filter. Values: 1 = fixed-term, 2 = permanent, 3 = temporary, 4 = freelance, 5 = apprenticeship, 6 = internship, 7 = volunteering.
contractType.title: Job contract

locations.description: French places to search in. Paste the values Leboncoin uses in its own URL, for example Paris, Lyon, 75015, d_75 (department), r_12 (region), or a full city code such as Paris__48.8566_2.3522_75056. Separate multiple places with one entry each.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Stop after this many ads. The actor stops sooner when Leboncoin runs out of matching results.
maxItems.title: Maximum ads

mileageMax.description: Vehicle filter: largest odometer reading in kilometres.
mileageMax.title: Maximum mileage (km)

mileageMin.description: Vehicle filter: smallest odometer reading in kilometres.
mileageMin.title: Minimum mileage (km)

ownerType.description: Keep every seller, only private individuals, or only professionals.
ownerType.title: Seller type

priceMax.description: Largest price to include. Leave empty for no upper bound.
priceMax.title: Maximum price (EUR)

priceMin.description: Smallest price to include. Leave empty for no lower bound.
priceMin.title: Minimum price (EUR)

realEstateType.description: Real-estate filter. Values: 1 = house, 2 = apartment, 3 = land, 4 = parking, 5 = other.
realEstateType.title: Property type

roomsMax.description: Real-estate filter: largest number of rooms.
roomsMax.title: Maximum rooms

roomsMin.description: Real-estate filter: smallest number of rooms.
roomsMin.title: Minimum rooms

search.description: Free-text keywords, for example a model, a neighbourhood, or a job title. Combine with a category and location for a narrower search.
search.title: Keywords

searchInTitle.description: Restrict the keyword match to ad titles instead of titles and descriptions.
searchInTitle.title: Search keywords in titles only

shippable.description: Return only ads where the seller offers shipping.
shippable.title: Shippable only

sort.description: How Leboncoin should order the results.
sort.title: Sort order

startUrls.description: Paste one or more leboncoin.fr search URLs. Every filter already in the URL is preserved (location, price, category, sort, property or vehicle filters). When you use this, the search filters below are ignored.
startUrls.title: Search URLs

surfaceMax.description: Real-estate filter: largest living area in square metres.
surfaceMax.title: Maximum surface (m²)

surfaceMin.description: Real-estate filter: smallest living area in square metres.
surfaceMin.title: Minimum surface (m²)
